sloka: इक्ष्वाकूणाम् हि सर्वेषाम् पुरोधाः परमा गतिः ।तस्मात् अनंतरम् सर्वे भवन्तो दैवतम् मम ॥१-५७-२२॥
transliteration: ikṣvākūṇām hi sarveṣām purodhāḥ paramā gatiḥ ।tasmāt anaṁtaram sarve bhavanto daivatam mama ॥1-57-22॥

translations.english: I consider destiny to be allpowerful. The effort of a man goes in vain. Everything is controlled by destiny. It is the supreme resort.
